text: The new removeFolder helper creates PromiseUrlListener, passes it to emptyTrash, then uses await listener. The actual class is a plain listener with a promise getter and no then method, so this await does not wait for URL-stop completion or observe that Promise's rejection. Await listener.promise when cleanup must wait for emptyTrash. The owned and accepted test blobs match and retain this site; this is a static completion-contract finding, not a reproduced cleanup race or failure.
title: The compose copy test awaits a URL-listener object instead of its completion Promise
